# Kollabary

> Kollabary is an AI-powered influencer marketing platform that serves as a direct bridge connecting verified creators with brands for campaign discovery, bidding, pitching, video asset trading, and collaboration.

Kollabary simplifies creator economy partnerships without holding funds or acting as an escrow/payout intermediary. Financial terms and payments for campaigns are handled directly between brands and creators. On Kollabary, in-platform KC Coins power platform interactions—enabling users to create campaign auctions, submit bids, pitch creative proposals, buy/sell video assets, and access platform features.

## Key Platform Features

- [Direct Brand-Creator Bridge](https://www.kollabary.com/features): Direct discovery and communication platform where financial terms are settled directly between brands and creators.
- [KC Coin Platform Economy](https://www.kollabary.com/features): In-platform credit system used for campaign creation, auction bidding, pitching, and video content sales.
- [Dynamic Bidding & Pitching](https://www.kollabary.com/features): Competitive marketplace where creators submit customized pitches and bids on brand campaign briefs.
- [Video Sales Marketplace](https://www.kollabary.com/features): Dedicated portal for creators to showcase, license, and sell video assets directly.
- [Verified Audience Analytics](https://www.kollabary.com/features): Real-time API integrations with YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok to inspect authentic audience reach and engagement history.
- [Prestige Ranking Engine](https://www.kollabary.com/features): Merit-based ranking system (Bronze to Diamond) evaluating creator activity and campaign track record.
- [Real-Time Collaboration Workspace](https://www.kollabary.com/features): Direct workspace messaging for brief negotiation, script revisions, draft video previews, and status tracking.
